entries.name: Rage
entries.description: As a Bonus Action, without Heavy armor, you enter a Rage: Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage, a bonus to the damage of Strength attacks, Advantage on Strength checks and saves. No Concentration or spells. It lasts while you keep attacking or forcing saves, up to 10 minutes.

entries.name: Unarmored Defense
entries.description: Without armor, your Armor Class equals 10 + your Dexterity and Constitution modifiers. You can still use a Shield.

entries.name: Weapon Mastery
entries.description: You use the mastery property of two kinds of Simple or Martial Melee weapons, more as you gain levels. After a Long Rest, you can change one of them.

entries.name: Danger Sense
entries.description: Advantage on Dexterity saving throws unless you are Incapacitated.

entries.name: Reckless Attack
entries.description: On your first attack of the turn, you can attack recklessly: Advantage on your Strength attacks until your next turn, but attacks against you have Advantage too.

entries.name: Barbarian Subclass
entries.description: You choose your Path, which grants you features at certain levels.

entries.name: Primal Knowledge
entries.description: One more Barbarian skill. While raging, your Acrobatics, Intimidation, Perception, Stealth or Survival checks can use Strength.

entries.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for, again at levels 8, 12 and 16.

entries.name: Extra Attack
entries.description: You attack twice whenever you take the Attack action.

entries.name: Fast Movement
entries.description: Your Speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor.

entries.name: Feral Instinct
entries.description: Advantage on Initiative rolls.

entries.name: Instinctive Pounce
entries.description: When you enter your Rage, you can move up to half your Speed.

entries.name: Brutal Strike
entries.description: With Reckless Attack, you can give up Advantage on one Strength attack: if it hits, it deals an extra 1d10 damage and an effect of your choice (push the target 15 feet, or reduce its Speed by 15 feet).

entries.name: Relentless Rage
entries.description: Dropped to 0 HP while raging, a DC 10 Constitution save leaves you standing with twice your level in HP. The DC rises by 5 each time, until your next rest.

entries.name: Improved Brutal Strike
entries.description: Two new Brutal Strike effects: the target has Disadvantage on its next save and can't make Opportunity Attacks, or the next attack by someone else against it gains +5.

entries.name: Persistent Rage
entries.description: When you roll Initiative, you regain all uses of Rage, once per Long Rest. Your Rage lasts 10 minutes without extending it, unless you fall Unconscious or don Heavy armor.

entries.name: Improved Brutal Strike
entries.description: Brutal Strike deals an extra 2d10 damage and applies two different effects.

entries.name: Indomitable Might
entries.description: If the total of a Strength check or save is lower than your Strength score, you use the score instead.

entries.name: Epic Boon
entries.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for.

entries.name: Primal Champion
entries.description: Your Strength and Constitution increase by 4, to a maximum of 25.

entries.name: Bardic Inspiration
entries.description: As a Bonus Action, a creature within 60 feet gains your Bardic Inspiration die (d6, larger with levels). Within an hour, it can add it to a failed check, attack or save. Uses equal to your Charisma modifier, regained on a Long Rest.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description: You cast Bard spells with Charisma, using a musical instrument as your focus.

entries.name: Expertise
entries.description: Your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for two of your skill proficiencies, two more at level 9.

entries.name: Jack of All Trades
entries.description: You add half your Proficiency Bonus to checks with skills you aren't proficient in.

entries.name: Bard Subclass
entries.description: You choose your College, which grants you features at certain levels.

entries.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for, again at levels 8, 12 and 16.

entries.name: Font of Inspiration
entries.description: You regain your Bardic Inspiration on a Short or Long Rest, and you can spend a spell slot to regain one use.

entries.name: Countercharm
entries.description: When you or a creature within 30 feet fails a save against Charmed or Frightened, your Reaction lets it reroll, with Advantage.

entries.name: Magical Secrets
entries.description: Your new prepared spells can come from the Bard, Cleric, Druid and Wizard spell lists.

entries.name: Superior Inspiration
entries.description: When you roll Initiative, you go back up to two uses of Bardic Inspiration if you have fewer.

entries.name: Epic Boon
entries.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for.

entries.name: Words of Creation
entries.description: Power Word Heal and Power Word Kill are always prepared, and each can target a second creature within 10 feet of the first.

entries.name: Divine Order
entries.description: You choose a role: Protector (Martial weapons and Heavy armor) or Thaumaturge (one extra cantrip, and your Wisdom modifier added to Arcana and Religion checks).

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description: You cast Cleric spells with Wisdom, using a Holy Symbol as your focus.

entries.name: Channel Divinity
entries.description: You channel divine energy: Divine Spark (heals or harms for 1d8 + Wisdom, more with levels) or Turn Undead (they flee for 1 minute on a failed save). Two uses, more with levels; one back on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest.

entries.name: Cleric Subclass
entries.description: You choose your Domain, which grants you features at certain levels.

entries.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for, again at levels 8, 12 and 16.

entries.name: Sear Undead
entries.description: When you Turn Undead, those that fail their save take a number of d8s of Radiant damage equal to your Wisdom modifier.

entries.name: Blessed Strikes
entries.description: Your choice: Divine Strike (an extra 1d8 Necrotic or Radiant damage once per turn with a weapon) or Potent Spellcasting (your Wisdom added to the damage of your Cleric cantrips).

entries.name: Divine Intervention
entries.description: Once per Long Rest, you cast a Cleric spell of level 5 or lower without a spell slot or Material components.

entries.name: Improved Blessed Strikes
entries.description: Divine Strike becomes 2d8; with Potent Spellcasting, your damaging cantrips also grant Temporary HP (twice your Wisdom) to you or an ally within 60 feet.

entries.name: Epic Boon
entries.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for.

entries.name: Greater Divine Intervention
entries.description: Your Divine Intervention can cast Wish; you must then wait 2d4 Long Rests before using it again.

entries.name: Druidic
entries.description: You know Druidic, the secret language of Druids, and Speak with Animals is always prepared.

entries.name: Primal Order
entries.description: You choose a role: Magician (one extra cantrip, and your Wisdom added to Arcana and Nature checks) or Warden (Martial weapons and Medium armor).

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description: You cast Druid spells with Wisdom, using a Druidic Focus.

entries.name: Wild Shape
entries.description: As a Bonus Action, you take the form of a Beast you know, for hours equal to half your level. You gain Temporary HP but can't cast spells. Two uses, more with levels; one back on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest.

entries.name: Wild Companion
entries.description: You spend a spell slot or a use of Wild Shape to cast Find Familiar without Material components; the familiar leaves at your next Long Rest.

entries.name: Druid Subclass
entries.description: You choose your Circle, which grants you features at certain levels.

entries.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for, again at levels 8, 12 and 16.

entries.name: Wild Resurgence
entries.description: With no Wild Shape left, a spell slot gives you one back, once per turn. Once per Long Rest, a use of Wild Shape gives you a level 1 spell slot.

entries.name: Elemental Fury
entries.description: Your choice: Potent Spellcasting (your Wisdom added to your Druid cantrip damage) or Primal Strike (an extra 1d8 Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder damage once per turn, with a weapon or a Beast attack).

entries.name: Improved Elemental Fury
entries.description: Your Druid cantrips' range increases by 300 feet, or your Primal Strike becomes 2d8.

entries.name: Beast Spells
entries.description: You can cast spells in Wild Shape, except those whose Material component has a cost or is consumed.

entries.name: Epic Boon
entries.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for.

entries.name: Archdruid
entries.description: When you roll Initiative with no Wild Shape left, you regain one. You can turn uses of Wild Shape into a spell slot (one per level), once per Long Rest. You age ten times more slowly.

entries.name: Fighting Style
entries.description: You gain a Fighting Style feat, which you can change each time you gain a Fighter level.

entries.name: Second Wind
entries.description: As a Bonus Action, you regain 1d10 + your level in HP. Two uses, more with levels; one back on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest.

entries.name: Weapon Mastery
entries.description: You use the mastery property of three kinds of Simple or Martial weapons, more as you gain levels. After a Long Rest, you can change one of them.

entries.name: Action Surge
entries.description: On your turn, you take one more action (not the Magic action). Once per Short or Long Rest, twice from level 17.

entries.name: Tactical Mind
entries.description: When you fail an ability check, you spend a Second Wind to add 1d10 to it; if it still fails, the use isn't spent.

entries.name: Fighter Subclass
entries.description: You choose your subclass, which grants you features at certain levels.

entries.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for, again at levels 6, 8, 12, 14 and 16.

entries.name: Extra Attack
entries.description: You attack twice whenever you take the Attack action.

entries.name: Tactical Shift
entries.description: When you use your Second Wind, you move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

entries.name: Indomitable
entries.description: You reroll a failed save with a bonus equal to your level. Once per Long Rest, twice at level 13, three times at level 17.

entries.name: Tactical Master
entries.description: When you attack with a weapon whose mastery you use, you can replace it with Push, Sap or Slow.

entries.name: Two Extra Attacks
entries.description: You attack three times whenever you take the Attack action.

entries.name: Studied Attacks
entries.description: When you miss a creature, you have Advantage on your next attack against it before the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Epic Boon
entries.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for.

entries.name: Three Extra Attacks
entries.description: You attack four times whenever you take the Attack action.

entries.name: Martial Arts
entries.description: Without armor or Shield, unarmed or with Monk weapons: your Martial Arts die (d6, larger with levels) for damage, Dexterity instead of Strength, and an Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action.

entries.name: Unarmored Defense
entries.description: Without armor or Shield, your Armor Class equals 10 + your Dexterity and Wisdom modifiers.

entries.name: Monk's Focus
entries.description: You have Focus Points (your level), regained on a Short or Long Rest. One point: Flurry of Blows (two Unarmed Strikes), Patient Defense (Disengage and Dodge) or Step of the Wind (Disengage and Dash, jump doubled), as a Bonus Action.

entries.name: Unarmored Movement
entries.description: Without armor or Shield, your Speed increases by 10 feet, more with levels.

entries.name: Uncanny Metabolism
entries.description: When you roll Initiative, you regain all Focus Points and your level + your Martial Arts die in HP. Once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Monk Subclass
entries.description: You choose your subclass, which grants you features at certain levels.

entries.name: Deflect Attacks
entries.description: With your Reaction, you reduce the Bludgeoning, Piercing or Slashing damage of an attack by 1d10 + Dexterity + your level. Reduced to 0, a Focus Point lets you redirect part of it.

entries.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for, again at levels 8, 12 and 16.

entries.name: Slow Fall
entries.description: With your Reaction, you reduce falling damage by five times your level.

entries.name: Extra Attack
entries.description: You attack twice whenever you take the Attack action.

entries.name: Stunning Strike
entries.description: Once per turn on a hit, a Focus Point forces a Constitution save: on a failure, the target is Stunned until your next turn; on a success, its Speed is halved and the next attack against it has Advantage.

entries.name: Empowered Strikes
entries.description: Your Unarmed Strikes can deal Force damage.

entries.name: Evasion
entries.description: Against an effect where a Dexterity save halves damage: no damage on a success, half on a failure.

entries.name: Acrobatic Movement
entries.description: Without armor or Shield, you can move along walls and across liquids on your turn.

entries.name: Heightened Focus
entries.description: Flurry of Blows gives three strikes; Patient Defense gives Temporary HP (two Martial Arts dice); Step of the Wind carries a willing creature with you.

entries.name: Self-Restoration
entries.description: At the end of each turn, you end Charmed, Frightened or Poisoned on yourself. Going without food and drink doesn't exhaust you.

entries.name: Deflect Energy
entries.description: Your Deflect Attacks works against every damage type.

entries.name: Disciplined Survivor
entries.description: You are proficient in all saving throws, and a Focus Point rerolls a failed save.

entries.name: Perfect Focus
entries.description: When you roll Initiative without Uncanny Metabolism, you go back up to 4 Focus Points if you have 3 or fewer.

entries.name: Superior Defense
entries.description: At the start of your turn, 3 Focus Points give you Resistance to all damage but Force for 1 minute.

entries.name: Epic Boon
entries.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for.

entries.name: Body and Mind
entries.description: Your Dexterity and Wisdom increase by 4, to a maximum of 25.

entries.name: Lay On Hands
entries.description: A pool of five times your level in HP, refilled on a Long Rest. As a Bonus Action, you touch a creature and restore HP from the pool, or spend 5 points to end Poisoned.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description: You cast Paladin spells with Charisma, using a Holy Symbol as your focus.

entries.name: Weapon Mastery
entries.description: You use the mastery property of two kinds of weapons you're proficient with, and can change them after a Long Rest.

entries.name: Fighting Style
entries.description: You gain a Fighting Style feat, or Blessed Warrior: two Cleric cantrips, cast with Charisma.

entries.name: Paladin's Smite
entries.description: Divine Smite is always prepared, and you can cast it without a slot once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Channel Divinity
entries.description: You channel divine energy, first for Divine Sense (you sense Celestials, Fiends and Undead within 60 feet for 10 minutes). Two uses, three at level 11; one back on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest.

entries.name: Paladin Subclass
entries.description: You swear an Oath, which grants you features at certain levels.

entries.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for, again at levels 8, 12 and 16.

entries.name: Extra Attack
entries.description: You attack twice whenever you take the Attack action.

entries.name: Faithful Steed
entries.description: Find Steed is always prepared, and you can cast it without a slot once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Aura of Protection
entries.description: You and your allies within 10 feet add your Charisma modifier to saving throws, unless you are Incapacitated.

entries.name: Abjure Foes
entries.description: With a Channel Divinity, as many creatures as your Charisma within 60 feet make a Wisdom save or are Frightened for 1 minute, doing only one thing per turn.

entries.name: Aura of Courage
entries.description: You and your allies in your Aura of Protection are immune to Frightened.

entries.name: Radiant Strikes
entries.description: Your Melee weapon and Unarmed attacks deal an extra 1d8 Radiant damage.

entries.name: Restoring Touch
entries.description: Your Lay On Hands can also end Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed or Stunned, for 5 points of the pool each.

entries.name: Aura Expansion
entries.description: Your Aura of Protection extends to 30 feet.

entries.name: Epic Boon
entries.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for.

entries.name: Favored Enemy
entries.description: Hunter's Mark is always prepared, and you can cast it twice without a slot (more with levels), regained on a Long Rest.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description: You cast Ranger spells with Wisdom, using a Druidic Focus.

entries.name: Weapon Mastery
entries.description: You use the mastery property of two kinds of weapons you're proficient with, and can change them after a Long Rest.

entries.name: Deft Explorer
entries.description: Expertise in one of your skill proficiencies, and two languages of your choice.

entries.name: Fighting Style
entries.description: You gain a Fighting Style feat, or Druidic Warrior: two Druid cantrips, cast with Wisdom.

entries.name: Ranger Subclass
entries.description: You choose your subclass, which grants you features at certain levels.

entries.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for, again at levels 8, 12 and 16.

entries.name: Extra Attack
entries.description: You attack twice whenever you take the Attack action.

entries.name: Roving
entries.description: Your Speed increases by 10 feet without Heavy armor, and you climb and swim at your Speed.

entries.name: Expertise
entries.description: Expertise in two more of your skill proficiencies.

entries.name: Tireless
entries.description: As a Magic action, you gain 1d8 + Wisdom Temporary HP, as many times as your Wisdom per Long Rest. A Short Rest reduces your Exhaustion by one level.

entries.name: Relentless Hunter
entries.description: Taking damage can't break your Concentration on Hunter's Mark.

entries.name: Nature's Veil
entries.description: As a Bonus Action, you become Invisible until the end of your next turn, as many times as your Wisdom per Long Rest.

entries.name: Precise Hunter
entries.description: Advantage on attacks against the creature marked by your Hunter's Mark.

entries.name: Feral Senses
entries.description: You gain Blindsight out to 30 feet.

entries.name: Epic Boon
entries.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for.

entries.name: Foe Slayer
entries.description: The damage die of Hunter's Mark becomes a d10 instead of a d6.

entries.name: Expertise
entries.description: Your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for two of your skill proficiencies, two more at level 6.

entries.name: Sneak Attack
entries.description: Once per turn, an extra 1d6 damage (more with levels) when you hit with a Finesse or Ranged weapon, if you have Advantage or an ally is within 5 feet of the target.

entries.name: Thieves' Cant
entries.description: You know Thieves' Cant and one other language of your choice.

entries.name: Weapon Mastery
entries.description: You use the mastery property of two kinds of weapons you're proficient with, and can change them after a Long Rest.

entries.name: Cunning Action
entries.description: As a Bonus Action, you can Dash, Disengage or Hide.

entries.name: Rogue Subclass
entries.description: You choose your subclass, which grants you features at certain levels.

entries.name: Steady Aim
entries.description: As a Bonus Action, if you haven't moved, your next attack this turn has Advantage, but your Speed drops to 0.

entries.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for, again at levels 8, 10, 12 and 16.

entries.name: Cunning Strike
entries.description: You give up Sneak Attack dice for an effect: poison the target, knock it Prone, or move away without Opportunity Attacks.

entries.name: Uncanny Dodge
entries.description: With your Reaction, you halve the damage of an attack from an attacker you can see.

entries.name: Evasion
entries.description: Against an effect where a Dexterity save halves damage: no damage on a success, half on a failure.

entries.name: Reliable Talent
entries.description: On a check with a skill or tool you're proficient in, a d20 roll of 9 or lower counts as a 10.

entries.name: Improved Cunning Strike
entries.description: You can add up to two Cunning Strike effects to a Sneak Attack.

entries.name: Devious Strikes
entries.description: New Cunning Strike effects: daze, knock out or blind the target (Constitution save).

entries.name: Slippery Mind
entries.description: You are proficient in Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

entries.name: Elusive
entries.description: No attack against you has Advantage unless you are Incapacitated.

entries.name: Epic Boon
entries.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for.

entries.name: Stroke of Luck
entries.description: A failed D20 Test becomes a 20, once per Short or Long Rest.

entries.name: Innate Sorcery
entries.description: As a Bonus Action, for 1 minute, your spell save DC rises by 1 and your spell attacks have Advantage. Twice per Long Rest.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description: You cast Sorcerer spells with Charisma, using an Arcane Focus.

entries.name: Font of Magic
entries.description: You have Sorcery Points (your level), regained on a Long Rest, which you turn into spell slots and back.

entries.name: Metamagic
entries.description: You choose two Metamagic options (more with levels) that alter your spells for Sorcery Points.

entries.name: Sorcerer Subclass
entries.description: You choose the origin of your magic, which grants you features at certain levels.

entries.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for, again at levels 8, 12 and 16.

entries.name: Sorcerous Restoration
entries.description: On a Short Rest, you regain Sorcery Points, up to half your level. Once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Sorcery Incarnate
entries.description: With no use left, 2 Sorcery Points activate Innate Sorcery; while active, you can use two Metamagic options on a spell.

entries.name: Epic Boon
entries.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for.

entries.name: Arcane Apotheosis
entries.description: While Innate Sorcery is active, one Metamagic option per turn costs nothing.

entries.name: Eldritch Invocations
entries.description: You gain an Eldritch Invocation, a piece of forbidden lore that grants a power (such as Pact of the Tome), more as you gain levels. Each level, you can change one.

entries.name: Pact Magic
entries.description: You cast Warlock spells with Charisma. Your Pact Magic slots are all of the same level and come back on a Short or Long Rest.

entries.name: Magical Cunning
entries.description: After a 1-minute rite, you regain half your Pact Magic slots. Once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Warlock Subclass
entries.description: You choose your Patron, which grants you features at certain levels.

entries.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for, again at levels 8, 12 and 16.

entries.name: Contact Patron
entries.description: Contact Other Plane is always prepared; once per Long Rest, you cast it without a slot to speak with your patron, succeeding on its save.

entries.name: Mystic Arcanum
entries.description: You choose a level 6 Warlock spell, cast once per Long Rest without a slot; then one of level 7, 8 and 9 as you gain levels.

entries.name: Epic Boon
entries.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for.

entries.name: Eldritch Master
entries.description: Your Magical Cunning gives back all your Pact Magic slots.

entries.name: Arcane Recovery
entries.description: Once a day, on a Short Rest, you regain spell slots worth up to half your level (none of level 6 or higher).

entries.name: Ritual Adept
entries.description: You can cast any Ritual spell in your spellbook as a Ritual, even unprepared, by reading from the book.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description: You cast Wizard spells with Intelligence, from your spellbook, using an Arcane Focus.

entries.name: Scholar
entries.description: Expertise in one of your proficient skills among Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature or Religion.

entries.name: Wizard Subclass
entries.description: You choose your subclass, which grants you features at certain levels.

entries.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for, again at levels 8, 12 and 16.

entries.name: Memorize Spell
entries.description: On a Short Rest, you replace one prepared spell of level 1 or higher with another from your spellbook.

entries.name: Spell Mastery
entries.description: A level 1 and a level 2 spell from your spellbook are always prepared and cast at their level without a slot.

entries.name: Epic Boon
entries.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for.

entries.name: Signature Spells
entries.description: Two level 3 spells from your spellbook are always prepared, and each casts once at level 3 without a slot per Short or Long Rest.

entries.name: Frenzy
entries.description: While raging, with Reckless Attack, your first Strength attack that hits deals extra d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus.

entries.name: Mindless Rage
entries.description: While raging, you are immune to Charmed and Frightened, and entering a Rage ends them.

entries.name: Retaliation
entries.description: When a creature within 5 feet damages you, your Reaction lets you make a melee attack against it.

entries.name: Intimidating Presence
entries.description: As a Bonus Action, creatures of your choice within 30 feet make a Wisdom save or are Frightened for 1 minute. Once per Long Rest, or by spending a use of Rage.

entries.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries.description: You gain proficiency in three skills of your choice.

entries.name: Cutting Words
entries.description: With your Reaction, you spend a Bardic Inspiration to subtract its die from a damage roll, or a successful check or attack, of a creature within 60 feet.

entries.name: Magical Discoveries
entries.description: You learn two spells from the Cleric, Druid or Wizard lists, always prepared.

entries.name: Peerless Skill
entries.description: When you fail a check or an attack, you can add your Bardic Inspiration die; if it still fails, the use isn't spent.

entries.name: Disciple of Life
entries.description: A spell cast with a slot that restores HP restores 2 + the slot's level more.

entries.name: Life Domain Spells
entries.description: Healing spells always prepared, more at each level step (Aid, Bless, Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration at level 3).

entries.name: Preserve Life
entries.description: With a Channel Divinity, you share five times your level in HP among Bloodied creatures within 30 feet, up to half their HP.

entries.name: Blessed Healer
entries.description: When a spell cast with a slot heals other creatures, you regain 2 + the slot's level in HP.

entries.name: Supreme Healing
entries.description: Your healing dice (spells, Channel Divinity) always give their highest number.

entries.name: Circle of the Land Spells
entries.description: After each Long Rest, you choose a land (arid, polar, temperate or tropical): its spells are prepared for your level.

entries.name: Land's Aid
entries.description: With a use of Wild Shape, flowers and thorns fill a 10-foot Sphere within 60 feet: 2d6 Necrotic damage to chosen creatures (Constitution save), and 2d6 HP to one creature. More with levels.

entries.name: Natural Recovery
entries.description: One Circle spell without a slot, once per Long Rest. On a Short Rest, you regain spell slots worth up to half your level.

entries.name: Nature's Ward
entries.description: You are immune to Poisoned, and resist the damage tied to your land (Fire, Cold, Lightning or Poison).

entries.name: Nature's Sanctuary
entries.description: With a use of Wild Shape, spectral trees fill a 15-foot Cube for 1 minute: Half Cover for you and your allies, who gain your resistance.

entries.name: Improved Critical
entries.description: Your weapon and Unarmed attacks score a Critical Hit on a 19 or 20.

entries.name: Remarkable Athlete
entries.description: Advantage on Initiative and Athletics checks; after a Critical Hit, you move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

entries.name: Additional Fighting Style
entries.description: You gain a second Fighting Style feat.

entries.name: Heroic Warrior
entries.description: In combat, when you start your turn without Heroic Inspiration, you give it to yourself.

entries.name: Superior Critical
entries.description: Your weapon and Unarmed attacks score a Critical Hit on an 18 to 20.

entries.name: Survivor
entries.description: Advantage on Death Saving Throws, and 18 to 20 count as a 20. At the start of each turn while Bloodied, you regain 5 + your Constitution in HP.

entries.name: Open Hand Technique
entries.description: Each hit of your Flurry of Blows can stop the target's Opportunity Attacks, push it 15 feet or knock it Prone (save).

entries.name: Wholeness of Body
entries.description: As a Bonus Action, you regain your Martial Arts die + Wisdom in HP, as many times as your Wisdom modifier per Long Rest.

entries.name: Fleet Step
entries.description: After another Bonus Action, you can also use Step of the Wind.

entries.name: Quivering Palm
entries.description: An Unarmed Strike and 4 Focus Points start lethal vibrations; when you end them, the target takes 10d12 Force damage (half on a Constitution save).

entries.name: Oath of Devotion Spells
entries.description: Spells always prepared, more at each level step (Protection from Evil and Good, Shield of Faith at level 3).

entries.name: Sacred Weapon
entries.description: When you attack, a Channel Divinity blesses your weapon for 10 minutes: your Charisma added to the attack, Radiant damage if you wish, and Bright Light within 20 feet.

entries.name: Aura of Devotion
entries.description: You and your allies in your Aura of Protection are immune to Charmed.

entries.name: Smite of Protection
entries.description: When you cast Divine Smite, you and your allies in your aura have Half Cover until your next turn.

entries.name: Holy Nimbus
entries.description: As a Bonus Action, for 10 minutes your aura shines: Advantage on saves against Fiend and Undead spells, and your Charisma + Proficiency in Radiant damage to enemies that start their turn there. Once per Long Rest, or with a level 5 slot.

entries.name: Hunter's Lore
entries.description: You know the Immunities, Resistances and Vulnerabilities of the creature marked by your Hunter's Mark.

entries.name: Hunter's Prey
entries.description: Your choice, changed after a rest: Colossus Slayer (an extra 1d8 damage once per turn against a wounded creature) or Horde Breaker (one more attack against another creature within 5 feet of the target).

entries.name: Defensive Tactics
entries.description: Your choice, changed after a rest: Escape the Horde (Disadvantage on Opportunity Attacks against you) or Multiattack Defense (Disadvantage on a creature's other attacks against you after it hits you).

entries.name: Superior Hunter's Prey
entries.description: Once per turn, the extra damage of Hunter's Mark also hits another creature within 30 feet of the first.

entries.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
entries.description: When you take damage, your Reaction gives you Resistance to that damage type until the end of the turn.

entries.name: Fast Hands
entries.description: As a Bonus Action, you pick a lock, disarm a trap, pick a pocket, or use an object.

entries.name: Second-Story Work
entries.description: You climb at your Speed, and your jumps use Dexterity instead of Strength.

entries.name: Supreme Sneak
entries.description: New Cunning Strike effect: while hidden, your attack doesn't reveal you if you end the turn behind cover.

entries.name: Use Magic Device
entries.description: Up to four attuned magic items, a one in six chance not to spend a charge, and you can use any Spell Scroll.

entries.name: Thief's Reflexes
entries.description: In the first round of combat, you take two turns: at your Initiative, then at your Initiative minus 10.

entries.name: Draconic Resilience
entries.description: Your HP maximum increases by 3, then by 1 per Sorcerer level. Without armor, your Armor Class equals 10 + Dexterity + Charisma.

entries.name: Draconic Spells
entries.description: Spells always prepared, more at each level step (Alter Self, Chromatic Orb, Command, Dragon's Breath at level 3).

entries.name: Elemental Affinity
entries.description: You choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Poison: you resist it, and your spells of that type add your Charisma to one damage roll.

entries.name: Dragon Wings
entries.description: As a Bonus Action, wings give you a Fly Speed of 60 feet for 1 hour. Once per Long Rest, or for 3 Sorcery Points.

entries.name: Dragon Companion
entries.description: You cast Summon Dragon without a Material component, once without a slot per Long Rest, and without Concentration (its duration becomes 1 minute).

entries.name: Dark One's Blessing
entries.description: When you, or someone within 10 feet of you, drop an enemy to 0 HP, you gain your Charisma + your level in Temporary HP.

entries.name: Fiend Spells
entries.description: Spells always prepared, more at each level step (Burning Hands, Command, Scorching Ray, Suggestion at level 3).

entries.name: Dark One's Own Luck
entries.description: You add 1d10 to a check or save, after seeing the roll, as many times as your Charisma per Long Rest, once per roll.

entries.name: Fiendish Resilience
entries.description: After each rest, you choose a damage type (not Force) that you resist.

entries.name: Hurl Through Hell
entries.description: Once per turn, a target you hit makes a Charisma save or hurtles through the Lower Planes: 8d10 Psychic damage and Incapacitated until your next turn. Once per Long Rest, or with a Pact Magic slot.

entries.name: Evocation Savant
entries.description: Two Evocation spells of level 2 or lower free in your spellbook, then one more at each new level of spell slots.

entries.name: Potent Cantrip
entries.description: A target that avoids your cantrip (missed attack or successful save) still takes half its damage.

entries.name: Sculpt Spells
entries.description: With an Evocation spell, 1 + its level creatures you can see succeed on their saves and take no damage.

entries.name: Empowered Evocation
entries.description: Your Wizard Evocation spells add your Intelligence to one damage roll.

entries.name: Overchannel
entries.description: A level 1 to 5 damaging spell deals maximum damage. Free the first time; after that, each use before a Long Rest deals you growing Necrotic damage.

entries.name: Magic Initiate
entries.description: Two cantrips and one level 1 spell from one list (Cleric, Druid or Wizard), the level 1 spell cast once per Long Rest without a slot.

entries.name: Alert
entries.description: You add your Proficiency Bonus to Initiative, and can swap your Initiative with a willing ally's.

entries.name: Savage Attacker
entries.description: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, you roll its damage dice twice and keep either result.

entries.name: Draconic Ancestry
entries.description: You descend from a dragon (black, blue, brass, bronze, copper, gold, green, red, silver or white): it sets the damage type of your breath weapon and the one you resist.

entries.name: Darkvision (60 ft.)
entries.description: You have Darkvision out to 60 feet.

entries.name: Draconic Flight
entries.description: From level 5, as a Bonus Action, spectral wings let you fly at your Speed for 10 minutes. Once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Darkvision (120 ft.)
entries.description: You have Darkvision out to 120 feet.

entries.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries.description: You resist Poison damage, and have Advantage on saves against the Poisoned condition.

entries.name: Dwarven Toughness
entries.description: Your HP maximum increases by 1 per level.

entries.name: Stonecunning
entries.description: As a Bonus Action, touching stone, you gain Tremorsense out to 60 feet for 10 minutes, as many times as your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

entries.name: Elven Lineage
entries.description: Your lineage (Drow, High Elf or Wood Elf) grants a power and spells, more at levels 3 and 5, always prepared.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries.description: Advantage on saves against the Charmed condition.

entries.name: Keen Senses
entries.description: You are proficient in Insight, Perception or Survival.

entries.name: Trance
entries.description: You don't sleep and magic can't put you to sleep; a Long Rest takes you 4 hours of meditation.

entries.name: Gnomish Cunning
entries.description: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

entries.name: Gnomish Lineage
entries.description: Your lineage (Forest or Rock Gnome) grants spells and a knack: speaking with animals, or building tiny devices.

entries.name: Giant Ancestry
entries.description: Your giant ancestor grants a power (teleport, cold, fire, push, stone or lightning), as many times as your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

entries.name: Large Form
entries.description: From level 5, as a Bonus Action, you become Large for 10 minutes: Advantage on Strength checks and 10 more feet of Speed. Once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries.description: Advantage to escape a grapple, and you carry like a creature one size larger.

entries.name: Brave
entries.description: Advantage on saves against the Frightened condition.

entries.name: Halfling Nimbleness
entries.description: You can move through the space of a larger creature, but can't stop there.

entries.name: Luck
entries.description: When your d20 shows a 1, you reroll it and use the new roll.

entries.name: Naturally Stealthy
entries.description: You can hide behind a creature larger than you.

entries.name: Resourceful
entries.description: You gain Heroic Inspiration after each Long Rest.

entries.name: Skillful
entries.description: You are proficient in one skill of your choice.

entries.name: Versatile
entries.description: You gain an Origin feat of your choice.

entries.name: Adrenaline Rush
entries.description: As a Bonus Action, you Dash and gain your Proficiency Bonus in Temporary HP, as many times as your Proficiency Bonus per Short or Long Rest.

entries.name: Relentless Endurance
entries.description: Reduced to 0 HP but not killed, you drop to 1 HP instead. Once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Fiendish Legacy
entries.description: Your legacy (Abyssal, Chthonic or Infernal) grants a resistance and spells, more at levels 3 and 5, always prepared.

entries.name: Otherworldly Presence
entries.description: You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip, cast with the ability of your Fiendish Legacy.
